title: SONiC Broadcom build failure in 202211 with error: "TypeError: request() got an unexpected keyword argument 'chunked'"
author: thovikeerthi
body:

comments.author: k-v1
comments.body:
Need to install new docker-py (https://github.com/docker/docker-py/pull/3116).
Instead of this
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/blob/ab5fd22a62a91c6645d2f0022b4428b3e9b6f6a9/build_debian.sh#L535
install `docker>=6.1.0`

Another solution: install `urllib3<2` and `requests<1.29`

comments.author: RogerX87
comments.body:
similar as @k-v1 

I used requests==2.28.1 in build_debian.sh as workaround now. can build pass.

`sudo https_proxy=$https_proxy LANG=C chroot $FILESYSTEM_ROOT pip3 install 'requests==2.28.1'`
`sudo https_proxy=$https_proxy LANG=C chroot $FILESYSTEM_ROOT pip3 install 'docker==5.0.3'`

like this.

comments.author: thovikeerthi
comments.body: Thanks. Issue got resolved by updating the docker py version to 6.1.0 in build_debian.sh file.

comments.body:
I faced the same issue.
Why not to create a PR and merge it?

linkedPullRequests.title: [Build] update python package docker in host image to 6.1.1
linkedPullRequests.author: k-v1

comments.author: k-v1
comments.body:
@xumia
Probably you can also review this.
New version of python package `docker` is enough to fix build failure.
Another solution is to pin `urllib3<2` and `requests<2.29`, but I think better solution is to use new version of `docker` package.
